title: Budget Execution — matrix view
description: Budget lines by category group, periods as columns, before any execution is recorded.

title: Open execution modal
description: Double-clicking an Ejecutado cell opens the execution list/create modal for that line and period.

title: Create execution — note required error
description: Submitting without a note is rejected client-side — note is mandatory for every entry type.

title: Create execution — form filled
description: Expense entry with amount and note, ready to submit.

title: Create execution — success
description: The new record appears in the modal list.

title: Matrix — updated Ejecutado total
description: The Ejecutado cell reflects the new execution total after closing the modal.

title: Currency toggle — USD
description: Amounts convert to USD at the cycle's exchange rate.

title: Currency toggle — back to GTQ
description: Toggling back restores the original GTQ amounts.

title: Collapse group
description: Collapsing a category group hides its category rows for a denser overview.

title: Delete execution — confirm
description: A first click arms a two-step confirm before the destructive delete.

title: Delete execution — success
description: The record list is empty again after delete.
